# lettermint_domain (Resource)

Manage a Lettermint sending domain.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "lettermint_domain" "example" {
  domain = "example.com"
}

output "lettermint_dns_records" {
  value = lettermint_domain.example.dns_records
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain` (String) Domain name.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation time.
- `dkim_mode` (String) DKIM management mode.
- `dns_records` (Attributes List) DNS records returned when the domain is created. A later read preserves these records when the API omits the optional relationship. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dns_records))
- `id` (String) Lettermint resource ID.
- `rotation_ready` (Boolean) Whether DKIM rotation is ready.
- `status_changed_at` (String) Last domain status change time.

<a id="nestedatt--dns_records"></a>
### Nested Schema for `dns_records`

Read-Only:

- `content` (String) DNS record content.
- `fqdn` (String) Fully qualified DNS name.
- `hostname` (String) DNS record hostname.
- `id` (String) DNS record ID.
- `last_checked_at` (String) Last verification check time.
- `purpose` (String) DNS record purpose.
- `required_for_verification` (Boolean) Whether Lettermint requires this record for verification.
- `status` (String) DNS verification status.
- `type` (String) DNS record type.
- `verification_scope` (String) DNS verification scope.
- `verified_at` (String) Verification time.

## Import

```shell
terraform import lettermint_domain.example 00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000000
```

An imported domain cannot recover `dns_records`. The provider does not request the optional DNS record relationship during a domain read.
